scope: Hessian-commutator Jennrich test on gl_3 (9 dims) for BILR residual.
interpretation: On gl_3 (9 dims), the trace form K has rank 9. For k=9 cubes forming a K-orthogonal system (M^T W M = K with W diagonal), the Hessian endomorphism H(X) = Hess_R(X) K^{-1} diagonalizes in the M-basis, so [H(X),H(Y)] = 0 for all X,Y. For k=10, the extra vector gives a rank-1 perturbation and [H,H] has rank <= 2. BILR with k=11 should give generic commutator rank > 0.
